sentences.text:
This is an application seeking to quash the FIR relating to Crime No.0104/23 registered with Police Station Dhantoli, District Nagpur City for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 417,
294, 323 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. It is the contention of applicants that the allegations levelled in the FIR are totally false.
According to the applicants the marriage was fixed, engagement ceremony was over as well as invitation cards were distributed.
According to the applicants, however, later on informant was insisted for separate residence that's why the marriage was not materialized.
On that basis, it is canvased that the allegations about apl 806.23. 2/2 4 the false promise of marriage is untenable.

4. Issue notice to the non-applicants, returnable after four weeks.
5.
Learned APP waives notice for the State.
6. In the meantime, investigation may go on but charge-sheet shall not be filed if already not filed.
